lines.zh: 我在大厅里慢悠悠地转。
lines.en: I wander the lobby at an easy pace.

lines.zh: 我的步子很沉，灰尘都跳起来。
lines.en: My steps are heavy; the dust jumps.

lines.zh: 我沿着桌椅走，绕开凳子。
lines.en: I walk the tables, skirting the stools.

lines.zh: 舞台那边有声音，我过去看看。
lines.en: Something's moving by the stage; I'll go look.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在想事情。
lines.en: Step, pause, step, as if thinking something over.

lines.zh: 地板被我的脚压得直响。
lines.en: The floorboards groan under my feet.

lines.zh: 我从台前走到门口，再走回来。
lines.en: I go from the stage to the door and back.

lines.zh: 我的帽子有点歪，不影响走路。
lines.en: My hat's a little crooked. Doesn't affect my walk.
My knee clicks when I lift my foot.

lines.zh: 这里空荡荡，脚步声回响。
lines.en: It's empty in here; my steps echo.

lines.zh: 我避开地上的电线，怕绊。
lines.en: I avoid the cables on the floor.

lines.zh: 我走到窗边，看了看外面。
lines.en: I walk to the window and look outside.
I stand here looking out over the seats.

lines.zh: 没有一个客人，我还是站着。
lines.en: No customers, and still I stand.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风举了举，没唱。
lines.en: I lift the microphone, but I don't sing.
My eyes sweep slowly around.
By day I'm just an ornament.
The oil in my joints has probably dried.
I hear wind on the roof.
I tilt my head as if listening.
It's quiet enough that I don't want to move.
I'm waiting for someone to push the door.
Oh. A guest.
Where will you sit? The front row's free.

lines.zh: 欢迎光临，今晚只有我一个。
lines.en: Welcome — tonight it's only me.
It isn't showtime yet.
My hands hang low. I've no plans to raise them.

lines.zh: 你看起来不太像来吃饭的。
lines.en: You don't look like you came to eat.
Don't touch me. I'm waiting for guests.
My smile doesn't change.
You've been standing there a while.
Shall I sing you one?

lines.zh: 这层外壳凹了，里面的电路还响。
lines.en: The shell is dented; the circuits inside still hum.

lines.zh: 棕色的熊，从台上下来了。
lines.en: The brown bear steps off the stage.
It hurts; my wiring's sparking.
The fabric has been cut open.
I look down at the gap.
That one makes me want to hit back.
I'm not unbreakable.

lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，又松开了。
lines.en: A joint caught, then released.
Stop hitting; I'll break.

lines.zh: 我的笑容还在，只是歪了。
lines.en: My smile's still there. Just crooked.

lines.zh: 披萨在柜台上，自己去拿。
lines.en: Pizza's on the counter. Help yourself.
Only after a hit do I start walking.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但看着挺好。
lines.en: I don't eat, but it looks nice.
Closer. Let me look.

lines.zh: 硬币投进机器，音乐就响。
lines.en: Drop a coin in and the music plays.
That door leads to the prop room.
What you're holding belongs to the staff.

lines.zh: 柜台上那块披萨，还冒着气。
lines.en: The pizza on the counter is still steaming.

lines.zh: 先动手的人，就别怪我锁上你。
lines.en: Strike first, and I lock onto you.
Open your hand so I can see.

lines.zh: 我的帽子压得太低，没看清。
lines.en: My hat sits too low; I didn't see you.

lines.zh: 扶正礼帽，我当你不是故意。
lines.en: I straighten my hat and assume it wasn't on purpose.
I step back to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的外壳很硬，你手疼吗？
lines.en: My shell is hard. Does your hand hurt?
I felt that one.
Don't crowd; there's plenty of room.

lines.zh: 你碰了我的胳膊，有点凉吧。
lines.en: You touched my arm. Cold, isn't it.
I'll stand still; go around.
You've stirred up the dust.
Mind the step. I've tripped on it.
I'm only a singing bear.

lines.zh: 这里没有别的活物，除了你。
lines.en: Nothing living here but you.

lines.zh: 你要留下过夜，我不反对。
lines.en: Stay the night if you like. I don't object.
My chest is hollow. Truly hollow.
I don't quite understand such things.
Could we wait for opening together?

lines.zh: 你在我旁边，我就不那么闷。
lines.en: With you beside me, I'm less bored.
Not too close; I might break you.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我就要变回摆设。
lines.en: At dawn I turn back into furniture.
Stand with me a while.
I bend and pick up a scrap of cloth.
A coin rolled under the stage.
I put it back in the cabinet.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指夹起电路板。
lines.en: I pinch the circuit board between two fingers.
Dropped things should be put away.
This circuit board can still be wired up.
I hold it up to the lamp.
I gather them slowly, in no rush.
Is this mine, or yours?

lines.zh: 我放在道具箱里，不会丢。
lines.en: It goes in the prop box. Nothing gets lost.

lines.zh: 你打我？那我就不客气了。
lines.en: You hit me? Then my manners are done.
I heard you swing.
There's a new mark on my shell.
You knocked on my shell; I woke.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我记住了。
lines.en: Not heavy, but I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 音乐停了，我把头转过来。
lines.en: The music stops; I turn my head.
I only wanted to stand here.
You've chosen the unfun version.

lines.zh: 你砍出的那道痕，我来还。
lines.en: I'll answer the mark you carved.
Don't think I won't hit back.
You struck my joint.
Fine. We'll do it your way.
I know this building better than you.
Try hitting me once more.
I don't often get angry.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，我可以看清你。
lines.en: The lights are still on. I can see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我绕过倒下的桌子，慢慢来。
lines.en: I round the fallen table, taking my time.
You've backed to the table.

lines.zh: 我的脚步不快，但没停过。
lines.en: My steps aren't fast, but they haven't stopped.
You circle, and so do I.
A chair caught you for a moment.

lines.zh: 你每踩一下，我就数一下。
lines.en: Every step you take, I count.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，我看着你的手。
lines.en: You hold up a weapon; I watch your hand.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我两步就到，麦克风还举着。
lines.en: At this distance I need two steps, microphone still raised.
The door behind you is locked.
I told you to stop hitting.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，但不是因为累。
lines.en: My joints are ticking, but not from fatigue.
You dodge well. Just slowly.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，不碰响椅子。
lines.en: I move along the wall, not touching the chairs.

lines.zh: 灯光在你背后，你成了影子。
lines.en: The light's behind you; you're a shadow now.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就贴上墙了。
lines.en: One more step back and you're on the wall.
You're breathing hard.
I'm in no hurry. I have all night.
My hat is crooked; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 从这里到门口，要经过我。
lines.en: To reach the door from here, you pass me.
Almost.
I raise my hand and push it forward.

lines.zh: 麦克风先挥到，手才跟上。
lines.en: The microphone swings first; the hand follows.

lines.zh: 二十点力道，隔着皮套落下。
lines.en: Twenty points fall through the suit.
You're shoved into the counter.
My top hat is crooked; straighten it.
My claws are hard.
You step back; I follow with one step.
I smile, microphone still raised.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢打人，但你逼我。
lines.en: I don't like hitting. You forced it.

lines.zh: 我的手臂摆动很慢，可很沉。
lines.en: My arm swings slowly, but heavy.
You blocked it, and your arm is shaking.
The stage light is on me.

lines.zh: 你打我的时候，声音真响。
lines.en: When you hit me, it made quite a sound.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你滑了出去。
lines.en: One shove and you slide away.

lines.zh: 这一掌把你的护甲压出坑。
lines.en: This palm dents your armor.

lines.zh: 二十点伤害，落在你的胸口。
lines.en: Twenty points of damage, right on your chest.
Your hand's pulling back.
That should calm you down.
I lower my hand.
Don't come again. I don't want to raise it.
The music box stops and I wake.

lines.zh: 我站在台上，灯光慢慢亮。
lines.en: I stand on stage as the lights come up.
My joints move and dust falls off.
No one's been in this building for days.

lines.zh: 音乐盒发条转完，我睁眼。
lines.en: The music box winds down; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走下舞台的台阶。
lines.en: I come down the stage steps slowly.
The lobby's empty. Just as I like it.
I pick up the microphone.
Someone pushed the door. I heard it.
I blink, and the eye lights come on.
Is it opening time?
I take my place on the spot.
My fabric fears fire most.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下，零件散开。
lines.en: I fall off the stage and parts scatter.

lines.zh: 水进来，我的线路短路了。
lines.en: Water gets in and my wiring shorts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我听见碎片声。
lines.en: The blast flips me; I hear pieces falling.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的壳上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my shell and won't come out.
That force leaves me unable to move.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但电池快空了。
lines.en: I don't eat, but my battery's nearly empty.

lines.zh: 雷打进来，我的眼睛全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning comes in and my eyes blaze.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No floor in the void; I keep falling.
